music_style: Sparse deadpan corporate satire chamber arrangement with sharp muted pizzicato and rhythmic clock ticking

voiceover_lines.text: So, Leo... where do you see yourself in five years?
voiceover_lines.voice_direction: Sharp, corporate, clinical, upper-executive tone, deliberate rhythmic cadence

voiceover_lines.text: Honestly? In your position. Ambitious... and what would you do if you got it?
voiceover_lines.voice_direction: Leo delivers flat deadpan line; Ms. Vance transitions into cool cynical amusement

voiceover_lines.text: Hire someone to answer stupid questions.
voiceover_lines.voice_direction: Unblinking deadpan, completely flat matter-of-fact delivery, zero vocal inflection

voiceover_lines.text: You're hired. We desperately need someone who can insult management.
voiceover_lines.voice_direction: Vance switches from strict executive to conspiratorial whisper-warmth, sarcastic relief
